column1: # This defines how the 8MB flash chip is divided into regions.
#   0xD000 - 0xEFFF : OTA data — tracks which app partition (app0 or app1) is active
#   0x2D0000 - 0x58FFFF : App partition 1 — OTA update firmware (2.75 MB)
#   0x590000 - 0x7FFFFF : SPIFFS/LittleFS — filesystem for data logging (2.4375 MB)
# The device can download new firmware to the inactive partition and swap on reboot.
